glosses: accidentally, casually, by chance, unintentionally, by the way

examples.en: I deleted the file by accident.

examples.text: Tom si è accidentalmente chiuso fuori dal suo ufficio.
examples.en: Tom accidentally locked himself out of his office.

examples.text: Accidentalmente si colpì il pollice col martello.
examples.en: He accidentally hit his thumb with the hammer.

examples.text: Tom ha rovesciato accidentalmente il suo drink.
examples.en: Tom accidentally knocked over his drink.
